name: Word input
description: A number from the external program drives the pin, scaled to a voltage

parameters.name: address
parameters.label: Address
parameters.description: Name of the signal in the external program, sent exactly as written (%IX0.10, %QW2)

parameters.name: Wmin
parameters.label: Word at the lower voltage
parameters.description: Number that stands for the lower voltage

parameters.name: Wmax
parameters.label: Word at the upper voltage
parameters.description: Number that stands for the upper voltage

parameters.name: position
parameters.label: Initial value
parameters.description: Where the value starts, from the lower (0 %) to the upper voltage (100 %); drag it to change it by hand
